implementation: Actual selected public imports only; save eligibility comes from selectors.canSaveConfigurationDraft(kind), save action delegates to existing actions.saveConfigurationDraft(kind) without local success or confirmation.

Exact fileSave epoch/workspaceId/path/kind binding gates display. Current confirmed save and prior revision save have distinct labels. Denial/conflict preserve text and show historical request prefix when non-current.

Pending/unknown/retained save and actual unsettled promise counter block load/save/baseline. Editing, kind selection, validate and discard remain available. No save retry/reload/content polling/automatic resend added.

Only fileSave.backupId is projected for confirmed saved matching selected scope. Closed safe basename and kind check; full root path uses existing configurationTargetPath separator and preserves literal POSIX backslashes. Backup body never read.

Saved-file versus loaded-file baseline provenance is explicit. A later pending/refused save can replace fileSave while keeping older baseline; that baseline uses neutral observed-file wording rather than a fabricated loaded/saved claim.

Temporary unsaved retention and actual save effects are distinct. Blank instructions save eligibility is independent of empty-invalid format validation. Missing-create and clear consent remain in actual Host dialog.
Existing CSS token hit target, 44px coarse media rule, focus outlines, wrapping, selectable paths and content, scrolling and event handlers preserved; new save section/status reuse CSS Modules.
